utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what exactly needs fixing on the drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly the cracks and that broken edge near the curb. I heard they’re checking the drainage too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do they know what’s causing the drainage issue, or is that still being checked?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can lend a hand with that. Tell me what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I think the sink was leaking again. Maybe start there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, let's take a look at the sink first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Heard the repair drive’s moving along; I saw a couple folks drop off supplies this morning. Pia, if you need a hand, I can pass that along.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess. I’d appreciate that, especially if there’s a good time window so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around and see what time window they’re aiming for, then I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Opal. Tell me what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The front brake on my bike is sticking, and the porch light is out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can take a look at both. If you want, I can help with the brake first and then check the porch light.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive this afternoon, so come by if you can lend a hand or need something fixed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll stop by if I can. Thank you for organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Glad to have you there. I’ll be by the community center around two, and we can fit you in wherever you’re most useful.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo — I’ve got the repair drive organized, and I can bring you the list of what still needs attention.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, bring the list and I’ll look it over.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ll bring it over now so we can go through it together.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what needs fixing on the repair drive? I want to make sure I have the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, it’s the usual list: the loose front gate, the porch light, and the cracked step by the driveway. I can walk you through it if you’re taking notes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, so I’m looking at the gate, porch light, and cracked step by the driveway. I can take notes if you want to keep going.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate it, but I need the school times first so I can see what fits.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Got it, I’ll check the school times and see what fits.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, just let me know what times work.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard it’s moving along, but I’m still catching up on the details. Is there anything you need from me for it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Just a quick hand with the word getting out would help. If you hear anyone who wants to pitch in, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely, I’ll pass that along if I hear anyone interested.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You mean you can really help with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yes, I mean it. I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that if you tell me what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, I just need to remember what’s broken first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, let’s go one thing at a time. What do you remember being broken?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive. I’ll check in with the others and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks. I’ll keep track of supplies and let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check in with the others and get back to you on what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s picking up steam. I can swing by after errands and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d help a lot. I can keep going through the list while you’re here.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll keep an eye on the list and make sure the rest gets handled while you’re here.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I might’ve missed a detail, but I’m here to help if you tell me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m not sure either, but let’s keep it simple: I can help with whatever’s left on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, let’s just tackle whatever’s left and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I think I missed what changed, but I can help out if you point me to it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll point you to it and catch you up if needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, point me to it and I’ll catch up as we go.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a wrench and my socket set if that helps. What’s the first thing we’re fixing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Start with the belt on the mower. That’s the one giving us the most trouble.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I’ll grab the mower belt tools and get started on that.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help organize the repair drive. Tell me what still needs doing, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Mara. I’ll start spreading the word and send you the list of what still needs attention.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, I’ll wait for your list and we’ll tackle it together.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard the repair drive's moving along nicely. If you want, I can help connect folks or pass along what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules. I’ve got the repair drive locations sorted, and I’ll pass along what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Glad to hear it, Opal. I can help spread the word if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Cleo. I’ve got the repair drive list organized, and I’m ready to help you get it moving.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll keep track of the supplies and make sure we’ve got what we need for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, then we’re set. I’ll keep the list tidy on my end, and we can check in once the supplies are in place.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive going on, but I’m still catching up on the details. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, it’s underway. I heard they’re taking in appliances, bikes, and small furniture for fixes this week.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s good to know. Do they need people to drop things off, or is there a pickup option too?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo. I’ll coordinate the school schedule around it and let you know what time works.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks, I’ll wait for the time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: What exactly needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d say the main things are the brake, chain, and tires, and I can check what needs tightening or replacement.
